details: O1G has optional mistake-only feedback, while the favorable mistake model supplies full labels.
proof: Any favorable-sequence full-feedback strategy can be used in the best-mistakes model, whereas an O1G learner must operate when feedback may be withheld and every supplied signal only identifies a mistake.  The full-feedback model can simulate O1G and may reveal strictly more information, so $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{best}}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{o1g}}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Occasional One-Sided Getback / Best Mistakes
